parse_gcc_cmdline_to_argv: parse a GCC command line string into an argv list using cmdline_to_argv
parse_gcc_invocation_from_argv: parse a GCC argv list into a GccInvocation object to extract defines, include paths, and sources
parse_gcc_invocation_from_cmdline: parse a GCC command line string into a GccInvocation object using the from_cmdline class method
extract_gcc_defines_and_includes: extract preprocessor defines and include paths from a GCC invocation using GccInvocation
restrict_gcc_to_single_source: create a new GccInvocation restricted to a single source file using restrict_to_one_source
